proof.text: Use Mathlib IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_sup and IntermediateField.finrank_sup_le (Mathlib/FieldTheory/IntermediateField/Adjoin/Basic.lean, lines 78 and 99) for the binary compositum directly. They give finiteness over the base and [EF:k] ≤ [E:k][F:k], avoiding the relative-degree conversion and tower multiplication. The two inclusions are le_sup_left and le_sup_right.

proof.text: For finiteness of a Fin n-indexed compositum use the Mathlib instance IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_iSup_of_finite. Each field is included by le_iSup. For the degree bound induct on n. At n=0, iSup_of_empty and IntermediateField.finrank_bot give degree one, equal to the empty product. At n+1, split Fin (n+1) into zero and successors using Fin.cases: the supremum equals E(0) sup the supremum of E(i.succ), by the two lattice inequalities. Apply the binary bound from step 1, multiply the induction inequality by the nonnegative natural number [E(0):k], and rewrite the product with Fin.prod_univ_succ. Nonemptiness is the existing PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField instance (bottom field). For E,F choose the actual supremum E sup F with its finite-dimensional instance; le_sup_left and le_sup_right are the common-upper-bound witnesses.

proof.text: By [def-weil-algebraic-closure], each element of PadicAlgCl is algebraic and hence integral over the base. For a finite subset S, apply [lem-weil-pbc-algebraic-generators-finite-extension] directly to S, using its Mathlib declaration IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin. Construct the witness as the actual intermediate field IntermediateField.adjoin k S, paired with that finiteness proof. IntermediateField.subset_adjoin proves every x in S belongs to it. This includes S empty and avoids choosing arbitrary witnesses or passing through singleton composita.

proof.text: Apply the finite-subset assertion of step 3 to {x}. Finset.mem_singleton_self puts x into the constructed finite intermediate field. Every such field is already an intermediate field of PadicAlgCl, so this existential membership is exactly the remaining inclusion in the union assertion.
